text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio spent her days in training, 
preparing for her next race... the Tenno 
Sho (Spring).

One day, a press conference was held, 
gathering the Umamusume competing in the 
Tenno Sho (Spring).

Tokai Teio makes a confident victory 
declaration. Following her lead, Mejiro 
McQueen also shares her feelings toward 
victory.

Betting their unyielding feelings against 
each other, Tokai Teio and Mejiro McQueen 
clash fiercely before the main event.
